title: Nonconformance Report
description: Nonconformance Report contract normalized from the DocuBricks Manufacturing library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Form
metadata:
  name: docubricks-manufacturing-nonconformance-report
  title: Nonconformance Report
  description: Nonconformance Report contract normalized from the DocuBricks Manufacturing library.
  version: manufacturing_nonconformance_report_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: manufacturing/nonconformance_report
    sourcePath: Schemas/manufacturing/nonconformance_report
    sourceVersion: manufacturing_nonconformance_report_v1
    sourceDigest: f1d875769aef7f469cc7d2da43055d6ad7ff5e329e8b613d7e93331c9b055402
spec:
  role: exception
  pages:
    - id: main
      title: Nonconformance Report
      sections:
        - id: dates-and-terms
          title: Dates And Terms
          description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: ncr-date
              name: ncr_date
              label: Ncr Date
              description: Date the nonconformance was opened.
              dataType: date
              widget: date
              required: true
            - id: closure-date
              name: closure_date
              label: Closure Date
              description: Closure date.
              dataType: date
              widget: date
        - id: document-details
          title: Document Details
          description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: ncr-number
              name: ncr_number
              label: Ncr Number
              description: Nonconformance report number.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: nonconformance-description
              name: nonconformance_description
              label: Nonconformance Description
              description: Description of nonconformance.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: detected-by
              name: detected_by
              label: Detected By
              description: Person, station, inspection, or process that detected the issue.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: quantity-affected
              name: quantity_affected
              label: Quantity Affected
              description: Quantity affected.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: root-cause-summary
              name: root_cause_summary
              label: Root Cause Summary
              description: Root cause summary if known.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: line-items
          title: Line Items
          description: Line Items fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: containment-actions
              name: containment_actions
              label: Containment Actions
              description: Containment actions taken.
              dataType: array
              widget: textarea
              span: 2
        - id: parties
          title: Parties
          description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: supplier-or-work-center
              name: supplier_or_work_center
              label: Supplier Or Work Center
              description: Supplier or internal work center.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: mrb-owner
              name: mrb_owner
              label: Mrb Owner
              description: Material review board owner or approver.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: property-or-asset
          title: Property Or Asset
          description: Property Or Asset fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: part-number
              name: part_number
              label: Part Number
              description: Affected part number.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: lot-number
              name: lot_number
              label: Lot Number
              description: Affected lot, batch, serial, or work order.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: risk-and-compliance
          title: Risk And Compliance
          description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: disposition
              name: disposition
              label: Disposition
              description: Scrap, rework, repair, use-as-is, return to supplier, or other disposition.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: status
              name: status
              label: Status
              description: Open, in review, closed, overdue, or other status.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
  validationRules:
    - id: ncr-number-present
      severity: error
      description: ncr_number is required for Nonconformance Report extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: ncr_number
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: ncr_number
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: ncr_number IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(ncr_number)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: ncr-date-present
      severity: error
      description: ncr_date is required for Nonconformance Report extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: ncr_date
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: ncr_date
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: ncr_date IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(ncr_date)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: part-number-present
      severity: error
      description: part_number is required for Nonconformance Report extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: part_number
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: part_number
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: part_number IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(part_number)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: nonconformance-description-present
      severity: error
      description: nonconformance_description is required for Nonconformance Report extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: nonconformance_description
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: nonconformance_description
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: nonconformance_description IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(nonconformance_description)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: disposition-present
      severity: error
      description: disposition is required for Nonconformance Report extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: disposition
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: disposition
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: disposition IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(disposition)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: quantity-affected-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: quantity_affected should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: quantity_affected
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: quantity_affected
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: quantity_affected IS NULL OR quantity_affected >= 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      ncr_number:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Nonconformance Report workflow.
      part_number:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Nonconformance Report workflow.
      nonconformance_description:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Nonconformance Report workflow.
      disposition:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Nonconformance Report workflow.
      ncr_date:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Required field for Nonconformance report extraction.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 6144
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Nonconformance Report documents combine manufacturing, quality, supplier, material, and operational
      control context.
  submissionSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      ncr_number:
        type: string
        description: Nonconformance report number.
      ncr_date:
        type: date
        description: Date the nonconformance was opened.
        format: date
      part_number:
        type: string
        description: Affected part number.
      lot_number:
        type: string
        description: Affected lot, batch, serial, or work order.
      supplier_or_work_center:
        type: string
        description: Supplier or internal work center.
      nonconformance_description:
        type: string
        description: Description of nonconformance.
      detected_by:
        type: string
        description: Person, station, inspection, or process that detected the issue.
      quantity_affected:
        type: number
        description: Quantity affected.
      containment_actions:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Containment actions taken.
      root_cause_summary:
        type: string
        description: Root cause summary if known.
      disposition:
        type: string
        description: Scrap, rework, repair, use-as-is, return to supplier, or other disposition.
      mrb_owner:
        type: string
        description: Material review board owner or approver.
      closure_date:
        type: date
        description: Closure date.
        format: date
      status:
        type: string
        description: Open, in review, closed, overdue, or other status.
    required:
      - ncr_number
      - ncr_date
      - part_number
      - nonconformance_description
      - disposition
    additionalProperties: false
    x-ladder-docubricks:
      completenessChecklist:
        - id: required_fields_present
          description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
          fields:
            - ncr_number
            - ncr_date
            - part_number
            - nonconformance_description
            - disposition
        - id: section_coverage_reviewed
          description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
          sections:
            - dates_and_terms
            - document_details
            - line_items
            - parties
            - property_or_asset
            - risk_and_compliance
        - id: nested_lists_normalized
          description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
          fields: []
